title: Global Gender Gap Report: Women's hard-won gains 'fragile'
summary: Two decades of progress toward gender parity is at risk as women's political representation declines, according to a new World Economic Forum report. At the current pace, the remaining gap could take 120 years to close.

title: Can Iran replace sea trade with land routes?
summary: Iran is shifting trade toward northern ports and land routes as its southern shipping faces a US blockade. Analysts say the corridors can keep essential goods moving, but cannot replace maritime trade.

title: Fed hike sends the Loonie to a six-week low
summary: The Fed has raised its rate to 3.75-4.00%, its first increase since 2023 and its first move since the cut in December 2025. The Bank of Canada has not moved at all.

title: WTI holds near daily low as Fed decision draws muted reaction
summary: Texas Intermediate (WTI) Oil holds near its daily low on Wednesday, showing little immediate reaction to the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement. At the time of writing, WTI trades around $97.50 per barrel, down roughly 3.3% on the day.

title: The Fed hikes six days after the ECB, weighing on the Euro
summary: The Fed has raised its rate to 3.75-4.00%, its first increase since 2023 and its first move of any kind since the cut in December 2025. Six days ago the European Central Bank (ECB) raised its deposit rate, the return banks earn on money parked with it, by the same quarter-point to 2.50%.
